description: The Modelica WasteWater library implements ASM1, ASM2d and ASM3 plus primary and secondary settling models. The repository records a 2015 Modelica conversion and earlier release history. This resource is provided by modelica-3rdparty (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Modelica License 1.1. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Simulation time uses days. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
